data.name: Anthropic Releases Claude Model With Longer Agent Runs
data.summary: Anthropic released a new Claude model on November 26 that it says can run coding and research tasks for several hours without help. Developers on X shared first tests, with mixed views on price and speed.
data.hook: Anthropic's newest Claude can work on a task for hours on its own, and developers are already comparing it with their current tools.

data.name: Indie Founders Debate Black Friday Discounts for SaaS
data.summary: Solo SaaS founders on X are split on whether Black Friday discounts bring lasting customers. Some report a spike in annual plans, others say most discount buyers cancel within three months.
data.hook: Black Friday deals fill the inbox, but founders disagree on whether discount buyers ever stay.

data.name: AI Researcher Predicts Wave of Job Losses by 2030
data.summary: A well-known AI researcher said on a podcast that AI agents could replace a large share of office work by 2030. The clip spread widely on X and drew pushback from economists.
data.hook: One podcast clip about AI and office jobs set off a day of arguments on X.

data.name: GitHub Ships Faster Code Review for Pull Requests
